name: manual_92d70d
claim: A missing credential on one execution surface does not establish that publication is unavailable everywhere; use an authorized authenticated surface and verify the exact tested tree and expected parent before updating a ref.

decisions.notes: CLI HTTPS push lacked a credential helper, while the connected GitHub app could publish identical trees. Remote commits were fetched and compared with tested local trees; commit metadata differed without changing files. This does not diagnose an earlier VM hang.
